summary: First-finish smoke test for The Casa. All 13 backend endpoint checks pass. Core frontend flows (home load, filter, detail, interest submit + redirect + toast, favorites, admin login OK/KO, admin dashboard tabs, settings elements) work end-to-end. No blockers.
passed: GET /api/properties returns 50 seeded properties with expected fields
GET /api/properties/{id} 200; hidden property returns 404 on public detail
Admin endpoints: 401 without token, 200 with Bearer token (properties, interests)
Filter by city Libreville updates results-count to 11
Interest dialog submits with valid data, shows success toast, redirects to /
Like button (like-btn-*) toggles favorite; /favoris shows 1 saved card
/admin wrong password shows French error indicator (Connexion échouée), stays on /admin
/admin correct login navigates to /admin/dashboard; tabs show Annonces (50), Demandes (2), Paramètres
Settings tab exposes settings-site-name, settings-color-picker, settings-save
notes: Admin edit/delete/hide/create dialogs and admin add-interest dialog were not exercised interactively in this latency-sensitive pass (defer to full QA). All corresponding admin API mutations verified directly against backend and testids exist in AdminDashboard.jsx as specified.
